name.zh: 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第七门 魔花使者

location.zh: 精灵太空站 暗黑武斗场 暗黑第七门

reward_note: Each door boss, when beaten, gave its 暗黑精灵's 精元 (4399 2010-06-04: 通关后获得精元), hatching the line's first stage.

capture.zh: 暗黑武斗场暗黑第七门：100级魔花使者，约1800血。打败获得魔花使者精元。

strategy_notes.zh: 先用雷伊消除强化，再用魔焰猩猩觉醒强化3次后秒杀。

engine_notes: Entry (original): 超能NoNo owners loaded the 反物质芯片 directly; others needed NoNo AI level 10 and a crafted 反物质芯片 (VIP-gated). Doors open in order: 试炼之门, then 暗黑第一门 … 第九门 (pre-2013). The remake drops the VIP gate.
heal_each_turn: 每回合自动回300血 — flat 300 (≈16.7% of 1800); the vocabulary's pct_max_hp form would be 16.67.
Its skills lower accuracy and speed (技能能减命中和速度).
Innate boost (天然自带强化; one player comment says 2 stages), stat not stated: atk+2, as unstated innate boosts are atk+2 (user decision 2026-10-19).
沼泽深渊 (20459, its species' level-73 move: speed -1 at 80%, accuracy -1 at 50%) replaces 要害攻击; it is the move that lowers accuracy and speed (百科, 4399 98441).
source_note: 4399 第七门攻略: No.438 草系 Lv100 HP1800, 每回合回300血.
